head: Acorns Invest Instead: Chrome button shows what a buy could grow to
dek: Acorns released Invest Instead, a free Chrome extension that puts a button next to Buy Now, Add to Cart and Add to Bag on shopping sites. It shows what the price could grow to if you invested it instead, assuming 8% a year for 30 years.
details: Acorns announced it on 19 November 2026; the extension is in the Chrome Web Store. The 8% return is an assumption, not a projection, and investing can lose money. In an Acorns survey of 3,242 of its customers, 61% said they'd likely use a button like this. Acorns also started season 2 of its comedy series Money Therapy on YouTube and Instagram on 18 November.
means: If you shop online in Chrome, you'll see a rough long-term figure next to the buy button; it's an estimate, not a promised return.
todo: To try it, add Acorns Invest Instead from the Chrome Web Store. Treat the number as a what-if, not advice.
thumb_words: ACORNS ADDS AN INVEST INSTEAD BUTTON
